sanskrit_verse: क्रियते धर्मतत्त्वज्ञैर् दूषितानां विशोधनम् । तस्मात् सत्येन भगवन् जलेश त्रातुं अर्हसि ॥
transliteration: kriyate dharmatattvajñair dūṣitānāṃ viśodhanam | tasmāt satyena bhagavan jaleśa trātuṃ arhasi ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those defiled by untruth must be purified through the knowledge of Dharma's essence; therefore, O Lord of the waters, you are duty-bound to protect through truth alone.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from alignment with Satya (Truth)
Causation originates in ontological clarity, not behavioral judgment
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by one’s proximity to Dharmic truth
Restoration logic operates through purification, not correction
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor exhibits defilement THEN initiate purification protocol via Dharmic knowledge exposure
IF claimant invokes protection THEN evaluate based on alignment with Satya, not intent
IF violation occurs THEN restore integrity through reconnection to source-consciousness, not penalty
IF adjudication required THEN refer to Dharma-tattva-jñāna as sole criterion for action
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, only those who possess direct realization of Dharma’s essence may act as arbiters. The threshold of responsibility lies in recognizing contamination by falsehood, necessitating purification rather than punishment. Authority flows from Satya, not institutional power.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that misalignment stems from ignorance of Satya. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how error manifests when consciousness departs from truth. Responsibility is proportional to one's capacity to recognize and return to Satya. Nyaya demands purification without infliction of suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Dharmic knowledge immersion until cognitive distortion dissolves
Assign responsibility through conscious reaffirmation of Satya
Reintegrate individual into community upon demonstration of purified cognition
Deploy Satyagraha-based resolution mechanisms to dissolve residual falsity
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. Justice executed solely for restoration. Reality affirmed as non-punitive. Consciousness stands as ultimate adjudicator.
